title: QuickStash Wand
description: Instantly stash items into containers with a wand (MATCHING/ALL modes).
body:
# QuickStash Wand (Paper plugin)

QuickStash adds a craftable **QuickStash Wand** that lets players quickly deposit items into containers *without opening the inventory UI*.

## Crafting

![Wand Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DI2ackCi/images/92e920978aa40264bc8789e1872c1466e5bd949a.png)

## How it works

- **Right-click a container** while holding the wand to stash items
- **Sneak + right-click** to toggle mode:
  - **MATCHING**: only stashes items that already exist in the container
  - **ALL**: stashes everything (configurable hotbar behavior)

## Commands & permissions

- `/quickstash give [player]` (`quickstash.give`)
- `/quickstash reload` (`quickstash.reload`)
- Use the wand (`quickstash.use`)

## Config

See `config.yml`:

- `stash.includeHotbar`: include hotbar items when stashing
